shortBio.en: Beach Boys songwriter/producer; Pet Sounds studio-as-instrument pillar.
shortBio.zh: Beach Boys 写手/制作；Pet Sounds 以工作室为乐器的支柱。

whyHub.en: Band face and studio author: Pet Sounds (1966) reframes pop production while he steps back from touring.
whyHub.zh: 乐队面孔与工作室作者：Pet Sounds（1966）重写流行制作，同时他退出巡演。

body.en:
Born 1942, Hawthorne. Writes early Beach Boys surf/car hits, then Pet Sounds with the Wrecking Crew—modular bass, stacked vocals, found percussion. Stops full touring mid-60s to live in the studio; Smile sessions stall, later revisited.

Hub: production method is the chronicle object as much as the band logo. Late solo Smile (2004) closes the unfinished 60s file.
body.zh:
1942 年生于霍桑。早写 Beach Boys 冲浪/汽车热曲，后以 Wrecking Crew 做 Pet Sounds——模块化贝斯、堆叠和声、现成打击乐。60 年代中退出全职巡演进棚；Smile 录音搁浅，后重访。

枢纽：制作方法与乐队 logo 同为编年对象。2004 独唱 Smile 合上未完成的 60 年代档案。

note.en: Primary writer/producer through Pet Sounds; sporadic later appearances.
note.zh: 至 Pet Sounds 的主笔/制作；其后偶有露面。
独唱专集，含完成版 Smile（2004）。
